verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an AI assistant built into the Statsig console that users can hand tasks to. The MCP server only exposes Statsig to external AI clients such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and Codex. AI Evals and the OpenAI integrations are tools for experimenting on customers' own AI features. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit toward a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
